reviews.text: Everything is perfect, the staff is friendly and kind, they treat the dogs with kindness and love ❤️

A truly positive experience! The staff is kind, professional, and very attentive to the animals' well-being. My dog ​​was treated with care and patience, and left feeling clean, smelling fresh, and happy. The atmosphere is welcoming and the service impeccable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality, expertise, and love for their four-legged friends. We'll definitely be back! Shop in San Giorgio a Cremano.

I have a 5-year-old Cocker Spaniel, and anyone who knows the breed knows how difficult and demanding her coat is, especially after a spay.
In recent years, Lola had a lot of undercoat and wool, impossible to manage or even comb. We traveled around Campania to have her thoroughly stripped, and beyond the excessive costs, she even had her hair shaved.
Then a grooming salon opened near our house, America Wash Dog. They were very gentle, very patient, and transformed my puppy. They are very knowledgeable, and what surprised us most was that after hours of bathing and trimming, she wasn't stressed as we often have been.
Thank you, we are infinitely grateful.
Excellent service. The staff was very friendly and helpful.
